Verified against the actual artifacts. findings.claim: "Four of the six branches read a key no tool in the catalogue declares at all; the fifth reads page ...; the last two read kind and decision from review_takeoff_item's schema (takeoffTools.ts:53)."
findings.evidence: Counted from source, the branches in describeToolIntent (permissions.ts:58,63,64,65,66,67,68,69,70,71,72) that read a key no tool schema declares are only THREE: :64 sheetIndex (no schema declares the key sheetIndex; the takeoff tools and manage_source_sheet use sheet/pageIndex — appTools.ts:385,390, takeoffTools.ts:38,50), :69 reviewer/decidedBy (review_takeoff_item uses actor — takeoffTools.ts:53, appTools.ts:395), and :70 knownDistanceM (calibrate_source_sheet uses knownDistance:{value,unit} — appTools.ts:385). `page` (:65) is NOT such a key: it is declared by read_assistant_file, read_source_geometry and prepare_source_room (appTools.ts:207,220,229). So the sentence names 4 + 1 + 2 = SEVEN branches for a stated total of six (it counts :69's two keys — reviewer and decidedBy — as two branches), and it lists `page` among keys 'no tool declares' when three tools do declare it. D4's own Where cell (lines 380-391) gives the correct partition: 'Three of those six read four keys ... A fourth (:65) reads page ... the last two (:67, :68) ... Three branches, one, two — the six in full' = 3+1+2 = 6. The defect column contradicts the row's own Where cell and M5 (which says 'three ... three is the number of branches that read a key no tool in the catalogue declares anywhere').
findings.fix: Change the defect column to: 'Three of the six branches read a key no tool in the catalogue declares at all; the fourth reads page, declared only by the three view tools, which never prompt; the last two read kind and decision from review_takeoff_item's schema.' — i.e. 'Four'→'Three' and 'the fifth'→'the fourth'.
